paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The average probing accuracy using different MLP variations. We indicate the size(s) of hidden layer(s) in square brackets.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the percent point difference across various hidden layer configurations, comparing the mBERT and XLM-R models. The horizontal axis presents the categories, labeled as "hidden:[50], linear", "hidden:[], linear", "hidden:[100], ReLU", and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU". The vertical axis represents the "% point difference" with a linear scale ranging from -0.2 to 0.2, and tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Each category contains two bars representing different models: mBERT, shown in light blue, and XLM-R, displayed in dark blue. In the "hidden:[50], linear" category, the mBERT bar has a negative approximate value of -0.2, while XLM-R has -0.05. The "hidden:[], linear" category shows mBERT with an approximate value of 0.09, and XLM-R with an approximate higher value of 0.21. For "hidden:[100], ReLU," mBERT is at approximately -0.11, and XLM-R is slightly above zero. In the "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU" group, mBERT and XLM-R both fall below zero, approximately at -0.17 and -0.12, respectively. The chart uses a legend to distinguish the models. Bars are not sorted in any specific order, nor is there any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any category. A legend is given top right.
